effects.description: [On Play] Your opponent cannot activate up to 1 [Blocker] Character that has 4000 power or less during this turn.
conditions: This Character is played onto the field
Your opponent has at least 1 [Blocker] Character with 4000 power or less
steps: (Optional) Choose up to 1 of your opponent's [Blocker] Characters with 4000 power or less
That Character cannot be activated during this turn
notes: This effect activates automatically when this Character is played
You can choose not to use this effect even if there is a valid target
The restriction lasts until the end of this turn
